newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Investcorp offers shares in Prime Service.
newsitem.headline: Investcorp offers shares in Prime Service.

text.p: The International investment group Investcorp said on Monday it was offering 26 percent of the equity in Prime Service Inc, in a public share offering.
"The offering is for 7,250,000 shares of the common stock of Prime Service, representing 26 percent of the total equity of the company and priced at $23.50 per share," it said in a statement.
"An option to purchase an additional 1,087,500 shares has been granted to the underwriters and managers to cover over allotments," it added.
The company's common stock will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange and settlement and closing of the offering is expected on November 6.
The Houston-based Prime Service was formed in 1962 and acquired by Investcorp and its clients in 1994 for around $300 million.
